ns2:course.label: Small Animal Internal Medicine
ns2:course.description: Clerkship in small animal internal medicine for VM-4 professional students. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Fourth-year standing in the veterinary medicine professional curriculum.
